message: Independent LONA validation now executes correctly on the same 100,000-bar LiteFinance MT5 dataset. We fixed a Backtrader flat-position counting bug and restored the missing Static/OrderBlock impulse proxy. Full-history result: +30.21% total return, 2,347 trades, 34.55% win rate, profit factor 1.04, expectancy +0.13 per trade and 21.27% maximum drawdown. This is encouraging cross-engine evidence, but LONA is still an approximation of the Python engine and the drawdown is too high to treat this as production-ready evidence. DEMO forward validation remains required.
